children.value: jīvanmuktatayā dhyānī na ca tatyāja tāṃ tanum
tāvatkālaṃ sa subhago na prābudhyata yogavit

asārvātmyena jñātāyāṃ citi alpayorapi
deśakālayorvistṛtadeśakālāntarakalpanāsāmarthye bhavatyeva niyativirodho natu
sarvātmikāyāṃ sarvaśaktisaṃpannāyāṃ parijñātāyāmityāśayena pariharati yathā yatra yadā buddhau niyamaḥ sa tadā sthitaḥ
yo yādṛgdṛḍhasaṃskāraḥ sa taṃ paśyati tādṛśam
etatsaṃvinnabho bhāti yatra yatra yathā yathā
mānasaḥ kila sargo'sau vītahavyasya tatra ye
tadidaṃ nāma te rāma kiṃ bhūyaḥ paribhāsate
vastutastu na tadrāma jagannaiva na cetarat
tavāpi na jagatsattā brahmedaṃ bhāti kevalam
bhāvi bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyacca yathedaṃ ca tathetarat

sphāraṃ kṛtaṃ tena jagacca dṛśya-
mevaṃ tataṃ naiva tataṃ ca kiṃcit
